title: What if the Moon were 10 times closer?
note: First live test of the Python studio (docs/runbooks/first-live-short.md). Validated by studio/tests/test_moon_plan.py.

video.title: What if the Moon were 10 times closer?
video.summary: A 15-second vertical Short: a quiet night town, the Moon ten times closer, tides flooding the coast, and a sky that is wall to wall Moon.
mustInclude: oversized Moon over a night town
cratered Moon surface filling the sky
video.rationale: Owner-chosen idea; three 5 s beats with real camera moves.

generation.style: realistic cinematic night, photographic, natural motion blur, no text, no people

locations.description: A quiet small coastal town at night under a clear sky: low rooftops with a few warm lit windows, a church steeple, a dark sea and a narrow shore beyond it, and a vast full Moon ten times larger than the real Moon hanging low and lighting everything in cold silver light.

script.text: Imagine the Moon were ten times closer.
Tides would climb far higher, flooding coasts twice a day.
And every night, the sky would be wall to wall Moon.

beats.prompt: Slow push-in on the quiet night town, the oversized Moon glowing above the rooftops, a faint mist over the shore
claims: The Moon is about 384,000 km away; ten times closer is about 38,400 km (an imagined scenario).

beats.prompt: Pan left as the huge Moon rises over the sea, heavy ocean tides surging up against the shore and flooding the low coast
beats.continuity: same giant Moon, same cold silver night light, same shoreline
claims: The Moon's pull raises the tides; a closer Moon would raise much higher tides.

beats.prompt: Zoom in on the cratered grey surface of the Moon, now filling the whole sky above the town, craters and mountain ridges in sharp detail
beats.continuity: same giant Moon, same cold silver night light
